jyutping: hou2 zung1 ji3 jam1 ngok6 ge3 N

english.note: Use this attributive construction when musical means fond of music, as in “a person who really likes music.”

examples.english: My son is a musical person.
examples.traditional: 我個仔係個好鍾意音樂嘅人。
